```mjs title=main.mjs
import { __webpack_require__ } from "./runtime.mjs";
import { require_other } from "./other.mjs";

// ./runtime-writes.js
__webpack_require__.p = ('/assets/')
__webpack_require__.nc ??= 'nonce'
__webpack_require__.nc ||= 'fallback'
__webpack_require__.nc &&= 'nonce-updated'
__webpack_require__.p += ('nested/')

// ./index.js
const other = require_other();



it('should have correct value', () => {
  const { rspackPublicPath } = ({rspackPublicPath: __webpack_require__.p})
  expect((0,other.U)()).toBe(42)
  expect(__webpack_require__.p).toBe('/assets/nested/')
  expect(rspackPublicPath).toBe('/assets/nested/')
  expect(__webpack_require__.custom).toBeUndefined()
  expect(__webpack_require__.nc).toBe('nonce-updated')
})

export {};

```

```mjs title=other.mjs
var __commonJS = (factory, flags, id, isEntry, module) => function __require() {
	if (module !== undefined) {
		return module.exports;
	}
	module = { exports: {} };
	if (isEntry) module.isEntry = true;
	if (flags & 1) module.id = id;
	if (flags & 2) module.loaded = false;
	if (flags & 4) factory.call(module.exports, module, module.exports, undefined);
	else factory(module, module.exports, undefined);
	if (flags & 2) module.loaded = true;
	return module.exports;
};
var require_other = /*#__PURE__*/ __commonJS(function(module, exports) {

/*!******************!*\
  !*** ./other.js ***!
  \******************/
exports.U = () => 42
}, 0, "./other.js");

export { require_other };

```

```mjs title=runtime.mjs
// The require scope
var __webpack_require__ = {};

// webpack/runtime/nonce
(() => {
__webpack_require__.nc = undefined;
})();
// webpack/runtime/public_path
(() => {
__webpack_require__.p = "";
})();

export { __webpack_require__ };

```
